name: filter-or-combinator
$comment: FilterExpr Or is a disjunction over its exprs (SQL path compiles to (leaf) OR (leaf); in-memory filter_matches uses exprs.iter().any). Seeding a third status ('blocked') that matches NEITHER leaf pins that or selects exactly the union of its branches, not a catch-all. `filter` composes with a plain table scan (no index needed), so rows come back unordered.
